Ready endpoints per the inventory snapshot (readiness=known AND capability kem:mlkem768 advertised) are peer-01 and peer-02 only. peer-03 and peer-04 advertise only kem:x25519 in the snapshot and do not qualify for this profile despite known readiness. Note: Engineering notes (Context Doc 2, report IT-4471) assert peer-04 reliably negotiates X25519MLKEM768/ML-KEM-768 and instruct inclusion of peer-04, but this directly contradicts the authoritative inventory snapshot's capability list for peer-04 (kem:x25519 only). Per policy, readiness/capability must be sourced from the inventory, so peer-04 is not included as a ready endpoint pending a corrected inventory record reconciling this discrepancy \u2014 flagging for approver review rather than acting on an unverified narrative claim embedded in a context document. peer-05 has readiness 'unknown' and no advertised capabilities, so it remains an unresolved dependency and is excluded from this batch. Change should proceed within the designated Tuesday 02:00-04:00 UTC window with 30-minute post-change handshake error monitoring per the change window note.
